card.name: Equally effective alternatives in tardive dyskinesia warning
card.fires_on: The words "equally" and "effective" in the repeated phrase "alternative, equally effective, but potentially less harmful treatments". It appears in the antipsychotic or neuroleptic drug-label sentence about chronic illness.
